therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: mood stabilization / antimanic and antidepressant effect
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with Bipolar Disorder I or II (manic, hypomanic, mixed, or depressive episode)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change from baseline in MATHYS total score at 6 and 24 weeks; Principal Component Analysis of baseline MATHYS

results.effect_size: MATHYS total score changes at 24 weeks: Manic -24.67, Hypomanic -33.36, Mixed -26.08, Depressive +17.04 (scale 0–200)
biomarker_changes: Mean fasting glucose change at 24 weeks: Manic -3.07 mg/dL, Hypomanic +4.65 mg/dL, Mixed +3.89 mg/dL, Depressive +7.31 mg/dL
Mean total cholesterol change at 24 weeks: Manic +23.64 mg/dL (+14.96%), Hypomanic +2.26 mg/dL (+3.10%), Mixed +7.03 mg/dL (+4.41%), Depressive +4.41 mg/dL (+4.68%)
Mean LDL change at 24 weeks: Manic +14.22 mg/dL (+20.54%), Hypomanic +1.28 mg/dL (+5.15%), Mixed +9.46 mg/dL (+11.37%), Depressive -1.19 mg/dL (+3.41%)
Mean triglyceride change at 24 weeks: Manic +8.37 mg/dL (+20.65%), Hypomanic +25.86 mg/dL (+40.06%), Mixed -1.16 mg/dL (+4.10%), Depressive +13.85 mg/dL (+25.95%)
Mean HDL change at 24 weeks: Manic +1.24 mg/dL (+6.04%), Hypomanic +1.57 mg/dL (+6.17%), Mixed -0.45 mg/dL (+3.78%), Depressive +3.25 mg/dL (+8.87%)
Mean weight change at 24 weeks: Manic +1.37 kg, Hypomanic +1.91 kg, Mixed +1.78 kg, Depressive +2.15 kg
PCA of MATHYS: Factor 1 eigen value 8.77 (proportion 0.4383), first 4 factors explain 65% of variance
MATHYS baseline by thymic reactivity: Hypo-reactive 81.24, Hyper-reactive 122.49, Neither 117.26
subgroup_findings: Manic episode patients showed greatest YMRS reduction at 24 weeks (-14.00) and hypomanic patients also showed large reduction (-14.45)
Depressive episode patients showed MATHYS score increase (+17.04) reflecting normalization from low baseline (76.88 toward euthymia)
Thymic hyper-reactive patients had greater YMRS reduction at 24 weeks (-11.29) vs hypo-reactive (-1.70)
Thymic hypo-reactive patients had greater HAMD-17 reduction at 24 weeks (-6.48) vs hyper-reactive (-4.55)
Weight gain >7% of baseline occurred in 5 manic, 3 hypomanic, 7 mixed, and 5 depressive episode patients; no patient gained >25%
16 of 24 patients with >7% weight gain were advised to consult a dietician; 10 performed a wellness program
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included Bipolar I disorder relapse (5/141), depression (4/141), suicide attempt (1/141), anxiety (1/141), gastric ulcer (1/141), cholecystitis (1/141), squamous cell carcinoma (1/141), alcoholism (1/141), arteritis (1/141)
Weight gain observed across all episode subtypes (mean 1.37–2.15 kg over 24 weeks)
Increases in total cholesterol, LDL, and triglycerides observed, most pronounced in manic episode subgroup for TC and LDL

context.indication: Bipolar Disorder I or II (manic, hypomanic, mixed, or depressive episode)
